zákona č. 40/2009 Sb., trestní zákoník, včetně nadpisu zní:
„§ 194
Dvojí manželství a partnerství
| (1) | Kdo za trvání svého manželství nebo partnerství podle občanského zákoníku uzavře jiné manželství nebo jiné partnerství, bude potrestán odnětím svobody až na dvě léta. |
| (2) | Stejně bude potrestán, kdo uzavře manželství nebo partnerství podle občanského zákoníku s osobou, která již je v jiném manželství nebo v jiném partnerství.“. |

translated_text:
§ 194

of Act No. 40/2009 Coll., the Criminal Code, including the heading, reads:
"§ 194
Bigamy and Partnership
| (1) | Whoever, during the subsistence of their marriage or partnership under the Civil Code, enters into another marriage or another partnership shall be punished by imprisonment for up to two years. |
| (2) | Whoever enters into a marriage or partnership under the Civil Code with a person who is already in another marriage or in another partnership shall be punished in the same manner.".

Art. IX
In Section 20(1)(f) of Act No. 150/2017 Coll., on Foreign Service and on Amendment of Certain Acts (Act on Foreign Service), the words "or partnership, if the legal order of the receiving State so permits" are added at the end of the text.
PART NINE
Amendment to the Act on Identity Cards (Art. 10)
Art. X
In Section 36(2) of Act No. 269/2021 Coll., on Identity Cards, paragraph (b) is repealed.
The existing paragraphs (c) and (d) are designated as paragraphs (b) and (c).
PART TEN
COMMON PROVISION (Art. 11)
Art. XI
Persons who entered into a registered partnership with each other before the date of entry into force of this Act may enter into a partnership under the Civil Code; the registered partnership thereby ceases to exist.
PART ELEVEN
Entry into Force (Art. 12)
Art. XII
This Act shall enter into force on 1 January 2025, with the exception of the provisions of Part Four, Art. IV, points 1, 2, 4, 22 and 28, which shall enter into force on 1 January 2027.
